title: American Express FY2022 10-K — Glossary of Selected Terminology: revenue and expense definitions (p.83)
key_points: 公司自定的 "Operating expenses" 口径为 salaries and employee benefits、professional services、data processing and equipment、other expenses，不含任何销货成本概念。
Discount revenue 定义为公司为促成 Card Member 与商户之间交易而从商户应付金额中赚取并保留的部分。
Interest expense 定义为主要为 Card Member 贷款与应收款、一般公司用途及流动性需求融资而产生的利息，分为 deposits 与 debt 两类。
Interest income 定义为 (i) interest on loans、(ii) interest and dividends on investment securities、(iii) interest income on deposits with banks and other 三部分。
Cobrand 协议下公司向 cobrand 合作伙伴支付款项，金额可相当可观，主要基于 Card Member 消费额及相应奖励。
词汇表未定义 "gross margin" 或 "gross profit"。

Discount revenue — Discount revenue represents the amount we earn and retain from the merchant payable for facilitating transactions between Card Members and merchants on payment products issued by American Express. ... Interest expense — Includes interest incurred primarily to fund Card Member loans and receivables, general corporate purposes and liquidity needs. Interest expense is divided principally into two categories: (i) deposits ... and (ii) debt ... Interest income — Includes (i) interest on loans, (ii) interest and dividends on investment securities and (iii) interest income on deposits with banks and other.

title: American Express FY2022 10-K — Note 1 revenue recognition: contra-revenue and processed revenue (pp.99-100)
key_points: Processed revenue 主要来自网络合作协议的royalties、费用及为促成网络合作方发卡交易而赚取的金额。
公司作为 American Express 网络运营方代网络发卡合作方与商户及第三方收单机构结算；受理费一般从向商户或收单机构的付款中扣除，并在 Card Member 交易发生时确认为 Processed revenue。
网络发卡合作方获得单独协商的 issuer rate，在存在同一客户收入的范围内记为 Processed revenue 内的 contra-revenue，超出部分记为 Business development 费用。
公司向商户、网络合作方及其他客户支付的合同款项分类为 contra-revenue，除非公司收到可确定并可计量公允价值的商品、服务或其他利益，此时记为费用。
Marketing 费用包含广告开发与首次投放成本，在广告首次投放期间费用化；其他营销费用一般于发生时费用化。
raw_excerpt: Processed revenue primarily represents revenues related to network partnership agreements, comprising royalties, fees and amounts earned for facilitating transactions on cards issued by network partners. ... Our network card issuing partners receive an issuer rate that is individually negotiated between that issuer and us and is recorded as contra-revenue within Processed revenue to the extent that there is revenue from the same customer, after which any additional issuer rate is recorded as expense in Business development. ... Contra-revenue — Payments made pursuant to contractual arrangements with our merchants, network partners, and other customers are classified as contra-revenue, except where we receive goods, services or other benefits for which the fair value is determinable and measurable, in which case they are recorded as expense.
